title: Gold is 32% below its January record. Why rising US rates are pulling it down, and what it means for India
short: Gold is 32% off its record. Why US rates are dragging it down
dek: Spot gold slipped below $3,800 an ounce on 17 November, its lowest in 14 months, as markets bet on more Fed hikes. Indian prices have fallen too, but a weak rupee and a 15% import duty change the picture at home.
card: Gold hit a 14-month low below $3,800 as Fed hike bets lifted the dollar. In India, 24K gold fell ₹11,340 per 10 g in nine days.
